title: docs(qa): crud-permission-matrix records the guest-anchor clause as a ruled product limit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GwrioG5ADPUvzoisipKr8y)_
Fixes #26623

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`crud-permission-matrix` 的 acceptance[5](guest 只建不读)不再记作 blocked(fixture),改记 blocked(dependency, #23267);knownGaps[2]、steps[5]、automated.ref 末句随之改写,revision 9 → 10 加一行 history。
- 为什么不写配方:没有任何门能把权限集绑到 guest 锚点。ADR-0138 D3 item 5 经 #23267 裁定 C(维护者:暂无公开站点或门户的产品计划)把绑定门推迟到有具体部署需要时再建。这是已裁定的产品限制,不是缺测试数据。
- 实测:在全新的 stock showcase 上走 REST,`PUT /api/v1/meta/position/guest` 返回 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE,建议绑定列表里没有 guest 行,匿名建和读 inquiry 都是 401。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 QA 台账 JSON 文件里的一个条目,不动产品代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期 OK。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, item `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` only:

- `fixtures.knownGaps[2]` now records clause 5 as a ruled product limit, not a fixture gap: record it `blocked(dependency)` with ref #23267. It cites ADR-0138 D3 item 5 as amended by ruling C on #23267 ([6159279205](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/23267#issuecomment-6159279205)), and lists every route that is refused: `PUT /api/v1/meta/position/guest` 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (pinned in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/guest-grants-channel.dogfood.test.ts`), `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` refusing a guest row, and the package door refusing a built-in position name. It keeps the member-persona and public-form reasons, adds that ADR-0138 D2 keeps `/api/v1/data` at 401 for anonymous callers even with the anchor bound, and names the in-process guest-channel cases that hold the clause's shape on an inline fixture (which score nothing here). Its last sentence says to write the recipe once the #23267 door exists.
- `steps[5]` says `blocked(dependency, #23267)` and why.
- The closing words of `automated.ref` say `blocked(dependency), #23267` instead of `blocked(fixture)`.
- `revision` 9 → 10, plus a `history` row citing #26623 that records the live re-drive below.

No area-level recipe and no `fixtures.provisioning` reference were added. A provisioning recipe needs a door a runner can replay, and `check:platform-checklist` refuses a recipe that no item references. No new card was filed: the product card for the missing door is #23267, which already exists and is ruled (closed, ruling C). Item-level `blocked` stays absent, since the other six clauses can be run on a stock boot.

## Why

Card #26623 asked for a recipe that binds the guest anchor so acceptance[5] can be scored. Its Done-when 4 covers this case: a gap that turns out to be a product limit stays blocked, with that limit's card as the ref. The old knownGaps[2] blamed the stock showcase ("the guest anchor ships unbound … binding is an admin action"). That reading sends every wave looking for a fixture that cannot exist, so the ledger now gives the real reason.

## Verification

acceptance[5] was re-driven once, REST only, on a fresh stock showcase boot (full `turbo run build` at main 1708115e2f, then `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4310`, no env posture), as the dev admin:

```text
POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email (admin)                         -> 200
GET  /api/v1/meta/position/guest                                 -> 200  _provenance "package", _packageId com.objectstack.plugin-security, no permissionSets
PUT  /api/v1/meta/position/guest {permissionSets:[showcase_guest_portal]} -> 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE  "'position/guest' is provided by a managed package and is sealed: it cannot be written here."
GET  /api/v1/meta/position/guest (re-read)                       -> 200  unchanged, no permissionSets
GET  /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings                         -> 200  one row: anchor "everyone", showcase_member_default, confirmed; no guest row
POST /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry (anonymous)                   -> 401 UNAUTHENTICATED
GET  /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry (anonymous)                   -> 401 UNAUTHENTICATED
```

Nothing was written, so there was nothing to tear down. The boot's temp DB was discarded.

Local gates on head e197a554 (main 57820085 merged in), derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 16 families, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:platform-checklist` prints `OK — 16 areas, 329 items … 8/8 recipes referenced`.

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's surface named steps, knownGaps[2] and history. The closing words of `automated.ref` were changed too (`blocked(fixture)` → `blocked(dependency), #23267`, one phrase), so the item does not contradict itself. Nothing else in the item and no other item was touched.
- ⚠️ PR #26905 edits other items in this file. Whichever PR lands second merges `origin/main` and re-runs `check-platform-checklist`.
